acceptance: GetFloorDetailQuery exists as C2 section 1 declares it: src/DungeonMaster.Application/Features/Dungeons/Queries/GetFloorDetail/GetFloorDetailQuery.cs declares, in namespace DungeonMaster.Application.Features.Dungeons.Queries.GetFloorDetail, 'public record GetFloorDetailQuery(Guid DungeonId, Guid FloorId)' implementing IQuery<FloorDto?>, where FloorDto is the existing DungeonMaster.Application.Features.Dungeons.Queries.GetDungeonDetail.FloorDto (not a new type). Evidence: read the file. At startRef the folder GetFloorDetail does not exist (ls src/DungeonMaster.Application/Features/Dungeons/Queries lists GetDungeonDetail and GetDungeons only).

GetFloorDetailQueryHandler exists as C2 section 1 declares it, in GetFloorDetailQueryHandler.cs in the same folder: 'public sealed class GetFloorDetailQueryHandler(IDungeonReadRepository readRepository)' implementing IQueryHandler<GetFloorDetailQuery, FloorDto?>, whose HandleAsync is a single delegation to an IDungeonReadRepository member, passing query.DungeonId, query.FloorId and the cancellationToken it received, in the shape of GetDungeonDetailQueryHandler.cs:13-20. Evidence: read the file.

The handler forwards the caller's cancellation token, not a fresh one (backend.md, Async discipline: 'Every asynchronous operation crossing a process boundary carries a cancellation mechanism'). A test in GetFloorDetailQueryHandlerTests.cs, with Substitute.For<IDungeonReadRepository>(), passes a token from a new CancellationTokenSource and asserts the repository member received that same token together with the query's DungeonId and FloorId. Name the test.

A test in GetFloorDetailQueryHandlerTests.cs asserts the handler returns the repository's FloorDto instance unchanged, and a second test asserts it returns null when the repository returns null. Name both tests.

The handler and the new repository method swallow nothing (backend.md, Error handling: 'Never swallow an error to keep a code path quiet'). 'grep -c catch' on GetFloorDetailQueryHandler.cs prints 0, and the repository method's body (quote its line range) contains no catch.

IDungeonReadRepository declares the floor-scoped read: a member returning Task<FloorDto?> taking the dungeon identifier, the floor identifier and a CancellationToken, whose XML documentation states that it returns null when no dungeon has the identifier and when that dungeon owns no floor with the identifier. Evidence: read src/DungeonMaster.Application/Common/Interfaces/IDungeonReadRepository.cs and quote the declaration with its line number. At startRef the interface declares two members (GetSummariesAsync, GetDetailAsync).

Query handler census: 'grep -rn --include=*.cs --exclude-dir=obj --exclude-dir=bin ": IQueryHandler<" src/DungeonMaster.Application/Features', run from the worktree root, prints exactly 3 lines, the new one being GetFloorDetailQueryHandler.cs. At startRef it prints 2 (C1 section 4.7). Re-run C1 section 4.7's must-match and near-miss reasoning on the new line and report it.

No Application command result type changed. This deliberately asserts preserved behaviour, re-measured: P-HANDLER (C1 section 4.7) with '| wc -l' prints 14 and with '| sha256sum' prints 2628445fc6c50e001c12594c2c8d7af20d559724088162d5a4f0d78838c857c8, the startRef values. Report both outputs and the 'ls src/DungeonMaster.Application/Features/Dungeons/Commands | wc -l' second count (14).

Repository test, happy path, in DungeonReadRepositoryFloorDetailTests.cs (deriving from SqliteInMemoryTestBase as DungeonReadRepositoryTests.cs does): seed one dungeon with at least two floors, the target floor carrying at least one area and at least one placed object; the floor-scoped read for (dungeon, target floor) returns a FloorDto equivalent (FluentAssertions BeEquivalentTo) to the element with the same Id of GetDetailAsync(dungeon)'s Floors (C2 section 2, first row). Name the test.

Repository test: the floor-scoped read returns null when the dungeon exists but owns no floor with the given floor identifier (C2 section 2, third row). Name the test.
Repository test: with two dungeons seeded, the floor-scoped read for (dungeon A, a floor of dungeon B) returns null (C2 section 2, fourth row). Name the test.
